newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African industrial shares bounce back.
newsitem.headline: S.African industrial shares bounce back.

text.p: South African industrial shares launched a late rally on Thursday to end in positive territory on the back of hopes Wall Street may soon make a come back, dealers said.
The recovery recouped opening losses on all the major indices after New York shares posted an overnight loss that restarted its recent correction.
Dealers said South African shares were joining in the herd mentality of most other major financial markets and waiting on U.S. shares' every move.
Gold shares, however, had another dull day, sinking early on bullion woes as European prices for the yellow metal sank below the psychologically important $350 an ounce level.

The gold index ended down 8.5 points to 1,289.0 after failing to join in the recovery enjoyed by industrials. The industrials index added 22.5 points to 8,202.3 as the all-share index ended unmoved at 6,981.1.
